# Working of Recursion

#### Course: Learn Recursion With C

## Working of Recursion

Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the function calls and the print values.

![Recursion Ends When n is 3](data:image/png;base64,)

The print_numbers() function calls itself until n equals 3.

When n equals 3, the base case is reached and the recursive calls are terminated by the return statement.

Here, the print_numbers() function doesn't return any value. Next, let's see how we can return values from recursive functions.
